mapper.sql: P.PGM_ID AS programId, P.PGM_NAME_HAN AS name, P.GROUP_NAME AS groupName, P.CATEGORY_CODE AS category, P.PGM_URL AS pagePath, P.MODULE_ID AS moduleId, (P.READ_USE_IND = 'Y') AS readUse, (P.WRITE_USE_IND = 'Y') AS writeUse, (P.EXPORT_USE_IND = 'Y') AS exportUse, (P.SUPER_ADMIN_IND = 'Y') AS superAdminOnly, (P.USE_IND = 'Y') AS active, P.PGM_SORT_NO AS sortOrder
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PGMMSTR P WHERE P.PGM_URL = #{pagePath} ORDER BY P.PGM_ID LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM PGMMSTR P ORDER BY P.PGM_SORT_NO, P.PGM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PGMMSTR (PGM_ID, PGM_NAME_HAN, PGM_URL, GROUP_NAME, MODULE_ID, CATEGORY_CODE, PGM_SORT_NO, SUPER_ADMIN_IND, READ_USE_IND, WRITE_USE_IND, EXPORT_USE_IND, USE_IND, SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_IP, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_IP, SYS_MUSR_DTTM) VALUES (#{programId}, #{name}, #{pagePath}, #{groupName}, #{moduleId}, #{category}, #{sortOrder}, IF(#{superAdminOnly}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{readUse}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{writeUse}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{exportUse}, 'Y', 'N'), IF(#{active}, 'Y', 'N'), #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE PGMMSTR SET PGM_NAME_HAN = #{name}, PGM_URL = #{pagePath}, GROUP_NAME = #{groupName}, MODULE_ID = #{moduleId}, CATEGORY_CODE = #{category}, PGM_SORT_NO = #{sortOrder}, SUPER_ADMIN_IND = IF(#{superAdminOnly}, 'Y', 'N'), READ_USE_IND = IF(#{readUse}, 'Y', 'N'), WRITE_USE_IND = IF(#{writeUse}, 'Y', 'N'), EXPORT_USE_IND = IF(#{exportUse}, 'Y', 'N'), USE_IND = IF(#{active}, 'Y', 'N'), SYS_MUSR_ID = #{sysUserId}, SYS_MUSR_IP = #{sysIp}, SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{sysAt} WHERE PGM_ID = #{programId}
